sourceRemark: 漫画网 manhua3.com。章节图片数据 AES-128-CBC 加密，正文规则用内置 hmd 桥解密；图片 CDN 的防盗链是「带任何 Referer 就返回占位图」，故 header 声明不发 Referer；章节地址用正则替换绕开 /jump 的 302（App 抓它只拿到空 body）。搜索有图形验证码（按频率触发），需先在「网页登录」里输一次验证码。
httpUserAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_2 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.2 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
ruleBookContent: @js:var m=result.match(/params\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);if(!m){''}else{var b=hmd.aesDecryptCBCBytes('39533824764a6e5532414e6553526f46','d894f36ec47225618dfe05a56a7fca59',m[1]);var i=0;while(i<b.length&&b[i]!==123){i++;}var u8=function(B){var o='',k=0;while(k<B.length){var c=B[k++];if(c<0x80){o+=String.fromCharCode(c);}else if(c<0xe0){o+=String.fromCharCode(((c&0x1f)<<6)|(B[k++]&0x3f));}else if(c<0xf0){o+=String.fromCharCode(((c&0x0f)<<12)|((B[k++]&0x3f)<<6)|(B[k++]&0x3f));}else{var cp=((c&7)<<18)|((B[k++]&0x3f)<<12)|((B[k++]&0x3f)<<6)|(B[k++]&0x3f);cp-=0x10000;o+=String.fromCharCode(0xd800+(cp>>10),0xdc00+(cp&0x3ff));}}return o;};var s=u8(b.slice(i));var e=s.lastIndexOf('}');var urls=[];try{var j=JSON.parse(s.slice(0,e+1));for(var n=0;n<j.images.length;n++){var t=j.images[n].split('/').pop();urls.push(hmd.atob(decodeURIComponent(t)));}}catch(x){urls=[];}JSON.stringify(urls);}
